mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_flow_task_candidate (tenant_id, task_id, parent_task_id, child_task_id, child_execution_id, process_instance_id, candidate_type, candidate_value, source, sign_mode, operator_id, reason, idempotency_key, request_digest, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{taskId}, #{parentTaskId}, #{childTaskId}, #{childExecutionId}, #{processInstanceId}, #{candidateType}, #{candidateValue}, #{source}, #{signMode}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestDigest}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, NOW())) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), source = VALUES(source), parent_task_id = VALUES(parent_task_id), child_task_id = VALUES(child_task_id), child_execution_id = VALUES(child_execution_id), sign_mode = VALUES(sign_mode), operator_id = VALUES(operator_id), reason = VALUES(reason), idempotency_key = VALUES(idempotency_key), request_digest = VALUES(request_digest), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, task_id AS taskId, parent_task_id AS parentTaskId, child_task_id AS childTaskId, child_execution_id AS childExecutionId, process_instance_id AS processInstanceId, candidate_type AS candidateType, candidate_value AS candidateValue, source, sign_mode AS signMode, operator_id AS operatorId, reason, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, request_digest AS requestDigest, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_flow_task_candidate WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND candidate_type = #{candidateType} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT tc.id, tc.task_id AS taskId, tc.parent_task_id AS parentTaskId, tc.child_task_id AS childTaskId, tc.process_instance_id AS processInstanceId, tc.candidate_value AS targetUserId, COALESCE( NULLIF(target_user.real_name, ''), NULLIF(target_user.username, '') ) AS targetUserName, tc.sign_mode AS signMode, tc.source, tc.status, tc.operator_id AS operatorId, tc.reason, tc.create_time AS createTime, tc.update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_flow_task_candidate tc LEFT JOIN sys_user target_user ON target_user.id = CAST(NULLIF(tc.candidate_value, '') AS UNSIGNED) AND tc.candidate_value REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND target_user.del_flag = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_tenant target_membership WHERE target_membership.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id AND target_membership.user_id = target_user.id AND target_membership.status = 1 ) WHERE tc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tc.parent_task_id = #{parentTaskId} AND tc.candidate_type = 'USER' AND tc.source = 'DYNAMIC_SIGN' ORDER BY tc.create_time ASC, tc.id ASC LIMIT 50

SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, task_id AS taskId, parent_task_id AS parentTaskId, child_task_id AS childTaskId, child_execution_id AS childExecutionId, process_instance_id AS processInstanceId, candidate_type AS candidateType, candidate_value AS candidateValue, source, sign_mode AS signMode, operator_id AS operatorId, reason, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, request_digest AS requestDigest, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_flow_task_candidate WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent_task_id = #{parentTaskId} AND candidate_type = 'USER' AND source = 'DYNAMIC_SIGN' AND candidate_value = #{candidateValue} AND status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
